title: IncuBrix Session
description: Persistent session state: source info, transcript, and the ordered edit history. The current timeline is always derived by replay(source, stack) and is never stored here.

stack.description: Ordered list of applied edits. The timeline is replay(source, stack). One instruction = one Edit = one undo step.

redo.description: Edits popped by undo that can be re-applied. Cleared whenever a new edit is pushed.

edit_counter.description: Monotonic counter used to generate edit IDs ('e1', 'e2', ...). Increments before use. Never reset, so IDs are never reused.

pending_question.description: If the last instruction returned needs_clarification, this stores the question and options awaiting a reply.

partial_ops.description: Resolved ops that are valid and will be applied once the question is answered.

edit.description: One instruction = one Edit containing resolved, source-anchored ops.

instruction.description: The original plain-language instruction from the creator.

ops.description: Resolved, source-anchored operations. All positions are source frames or word IDs.
